guide.name: 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest
guide.cityList: 24 Las Vegas distinctions: 4 starred (5 stars), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended
guide.sourceLabel: Visit Las Vegas (Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority) — official MICHELIN list page
guide.note: 2027 awards have not been announced. A 2026 distinction is not a guarantee of 2027 status.

primarySource.label: MICHELIN Guide Southwest 2026 — official press release, 31 Aug 2026
primarySource.note: Added by session 4d7b292f as the first-party primary source behind the LVCVA page. It confirms the ceremony was held at Fontainebleau Las Vegas, lists every starred and Recommended restaurant with its street address, and states the full Southwest selection is 64 restaurants across 24 cuisine types. The fifth starred restaurant, Monte, is in South Salt Lake, UTAH — not Las Vegas — which is why Las Vegas has 4 starred restaurants and 5 stars, not 5 starred restaurants.

rows.name: Joël Robuchon
rows.hours: Tue–Sat 5:00–9:30 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
rows.priceNote: Menu listed on the official page without prices. A two-person total is not published.
rows.note: $$$$ · Business Formal dress code · Reservations 702.891.7925 · children under 6 not accepted. Awarded Two Stars, 2026 (only Las Vegas restaurant with two). Also a 2026 MICHELIN Service Award (Sean Christopher) and Forbes Five-Star.

rows.name: é by José Andrés
rows.hours: Tue–Sun, two seatings nightly at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM. CLOSED Monday.
rows.note: Only 9 seats at a chef's counter inside Jaleo, third floor of The Cosmopolitan. Tickets are released THREE MONTHS in advance, with a waitlist — for a Feb 15–18 2027 stay that window is already open. Phone +1 702-698-7950, reserve@ebyjoseandres.com. No ticket price is published on the official site, so cost for two stays blank.

rows.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
rows.hours: Mon 5:00–9:30 PM; Thu–Sun 5:00–9:30 PM. CLOSED Tuesday and Wednesday.
rows.note: $$$ · Business Casual · Reservations 702.891.7358 · children 6 and under not accepted · 34-seat counter facing the open kitchen. One MICHELIN Star 2026; Forbes Travel Guide Four Stars; AAA Four Diamond; Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence. IMPORTANT PAIRING: Joël Robuchon is closed Mon/Sun and L'Atelier is closed Tue/Wed, so between them MGM Grand has a starred restaurant open all 7 nights but never both on the same night.

rows.name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
rows.hours: Official live status shows 'Opens 5:00 PM'. Open days were not exposed in the retrieved page text.

social.label: Caesars Palace Instagram (property account, official footer link)

rows.note: $$$$ · Formal dress · (702) 731-7286, groups (866) 733-5827. rows.name: Anima by EDO
rows.priceNote: VERIFIED official site: 'Anima Experience' tasting menu $85 per person, so $170 for two adults before tax, tip and wine pairings. The tasting runs ~2 to 2.5 hours and the entire table must participate. Vegetarian and vegan tastings available on request. Separate Monday special: two handmade pasta dishes plus one select bottle of wine for $65 (a table price, not per person).
rows.note: Cheapest published tasting-menu total for two of all 24 listed restaurants. At The Gramercy, 9205 W Russell Rd #185 — off-Strip southwest, so it needs a car or rideshare rather than a Strip bus.

rows.name: Partage
rows.priceNote: VERIFIED official menu: 5 courses $130 per person ($260 for two, ~1.5 h); 7 courses $160 pp ($320 for two, ~2.5 h); Signature 9 courses $210 pp ($420 for two, ~3 h). Before tax and tip. Wine pairing per person: 5-glass $60, 7-glass $84, 9-glass $108; premium add $40/$56/$72; 5-glass Champagne $125. Seared foie gras add-on +$33 pp. Automatic 20% gratuity applies only to parties of 6 or more, so it does NOT apply to two.
rows.note: Menu changes monthly. The official site states it CANNOT accommodate vegan, dairy-free, celiac, or garlic/onion-free diets. 12-seat private room available. Hours are not confirmed — a prior session found the venue site and the MICHELIN listing disagree.
